structured_output.what_is_happening: x/acc is a pump.fun coin that has already graduated to PumpSwap. Its created and migrated timestamps are the same second, which means it bonded instantly at launch. That usually points to a bundled or pre-arranged launch. About 10–12 minutes after the pool opened, it had about $248k of volume, 989 unique buyers against 135 unique sellers, and a 5-minute price change of +125–154%. Market cap went from $148k at detection to $191k at collection, with an all-time high of $240k. The coin's X link is an old AdrianDittmann post (Musk-adjacent), and the narrative is 'x/acc', meaning X or accelerationism. An earlier token with the same name has already died: $0 liquidity, $4k market cap, created about 23 minutes before this one.

narrative.description: x/acc: an accelerationist, space and X/Elon-adjacent meme. It borrows credibility by linking to an old AdrianDittmann tweet rather than a project account. The description text is generic ('eyes on the stars').
narrative.why_spreading: Elon/X-adjacent 'acc' memes pull in degen flow easily. The wave of unique buyers suggests the coin is on trending feeds or screens (pump.fun/GMGN/axiom), not that there is real outside news. There is no evidence of a new catalyst; the linked tweet is from 2023.

token_connection.why_this_token: This is the second x/acc launch and the one that caught flow after the first one died. It has a website (xacctoken.site) and an image that isn't a duplicate. Its link to the narrative is only the name and a borrowed tweet link.
token_connection.competing_tokens: FL4Um...pump x/acc, launched about 23 minutes earlier, now $0 liquidity and $4k market cap after $134k of hourly volume. It rugged or dumped. More copies are likely if the meme keeps moving.

authenticity.evidence: For: 989 unique buyers against 135 sellers, 890 holders, top 10 holding only 3.9%, very low bot/degen and fresh-wallet rates, no paid boosts, no DexScreener profile. Against: GMGN flags 54 bundler wallets holding about 9.9%. The top holders are unusually uniform (about 0.38% each), which looks like supply split across bundle wallets. Creation and migration happened at the same instant. The creator wallet is closed. The previous same-name token died within minutes.
authenticity.uncertainty: I can't tell whether the uniform 0.38% holders are the bundle or just early buyers of similar size. I also can't see any X or call-channel promotion.

structural_risks: Bundled launch: 54 bundler wallets, about 10% of supply, spread across many wallets with near-identical balances. This is a coordinated-dump risk.
Instant migration: the creator likely bought through the curve in the same block.
The creator wallet is closed, so the dev may already have exited.
The earlier same-ticker token rugged, so this could be a serial pattern.
Liquidity is $38.8k against a $191k market cap. That's fine, but a 2x needs about $400k market cap, and a 5-minute pump like this one is often near a local top.

structured_output.counterargument: I scored this only moderately, but the buyer breadth is exceptional: about 1,000 unique buyers in about 12 minutes, a 7:1 buyer-to-seller ratio, a flat holder distribution, burned LP and clean authorities. At a $191k market cap with an Elon/X-adjacent meme, a run to $400k+ within 6 hours is quite reachable. The LP can't be pulled, so the real downside is a bleed, not a zero.

structured_output.thesis: Strong early breadth and clean structure (burned LP, renounced authorities, low top-10 concentration) make this better than the typical coin in the pool. Against that: a bundled instant-migration launch, a closed creator wallet, a dead same-name predecessor, and entry right after a parabolic 5-minute candle. A 2x before a -50% move is plausible but not the base case.
